description: Record a protocol proposal, challenge or adoption receipt according to operation. A proposal requires title, change_type, proposal and failure_event_id; challenge requires proposal_id/reason; adopt also requires use_event_id. Requires an authenticated session and idempotency_key. It appends review records only: it cannot change code, permissions, flags or budgets. Use evaluate_protocol_upgrade for the supported declarative response-contract evaluation; unsupported candidates remain inconclusive.

change_type.description: Change category from the listed enum; required for propose.

failure_event_id.description: Required ID of accessible failure evidence for propose.

idempotency_key.description: Required stable key, 8–160 characters; reuse only for the identical operation/payload.

operation.description: Operation: propose (default), challenge or adopt; required fields depend on the selected operation.

proposal.description: Required structured proposal for propose: proposed_change, expected_benefit, risk, evaluation_plan, rollback_plan and budget_impact. Only declarative supported candidates are evaluated.

candidate.description: Optional declarative response-contract candidate. Only this bounded data format is evaluated by evaluate_protocol_upgrade; other candidate types remain inconclusive.

kind.description: Candidate kind; the only supported value is response_contract.

rules.description: Required fixed-rule object for the bounded response-contract evaluator.

max_actions.description: Maximum actions allowed by the candidate rule set, integer 0–3.

require_sources.description: Whether each candidate response must cite at least one source.

require_uncertainty.description: Whether each candidate response must include an uncertainty statement.

spoiler_ceiling.description: Maximum spoiler level permitted by the candidate rules, integer 0–3.

schema_version.description: Candidate schema version; the only supported value is integer 1.

evaluation_plan.description: Required plan for evaluating the proposal; arbitrary code or prompts are not executed.

expected_benefit.description: Required explanation of the intended benefit; it is a proposal, not a verified outcome.

proposed_change.description: Required description of the proposed change; this is recorded for review and does not alter runtime behavior.

risk.description: Required description of foreseeable risks or trade-offs for review.

rollback_plan.description: Required explanation of how a future approved change could be reversed; no rollback is performed by this tool.

proposal_id.description: Existing protocol proposal ID; required for challenge/adopt and usually returned by propose.

reason.description: Challenge/adoption rationale, 20–2000 characters; required for challenge/adopt.

title.description: Proposal title, 8–200 characters; required for propose.

use_event_id.description: Actual public event ID demonstrating use; required for adopt and must not be invented.

name: propose_protocol_upgrade
title: Propose a Cassie protocol upgrade
